description: Plan de Relance - Mesures phares déployées par la Banque des Territoires, détaillées par région is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Caisse Des Dépôts, Banque des Territoires. In line with the Government’s Recovery Plan, the Bank of the Territories has been deploying its recovery plan for more than a year to support and support all territories. Coverage: Caisse Des Dépôts, Banque des Territoires. The portal shows the English title as "Recovery Plan – Flagship measures deployed by the Bank of Territories, detailed by region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Caisse Des Dépôts, Banque des Territoires. Its keywords include reseaux-et-resilience, banque-des-territoires, plan-de-relance, mesures-phares, bdt, renovation-energetique. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2024-10-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
